page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head across the top with page number 304 at left. Below it an indented list of numbered questions (7–14) in italic, then a paragraph beginning with a large initial H, continuing in roman type to the foot. No margin notes. Digitiser watermark at bottom right, not transcribed.

main_text.l: 7. Quale, si de missione in possessionem feudi?
8. Quale, si de bonis mobilibus, controversia?
9. Quid statuendum, casu quo duobus in locis quis habet domicilium?
10. Casus deciditur, quo jure Aesdonico & Scabinico, in mobilia succeditur, ratione statuti loci, ubi quis moritur.
11. Quale statutum spectandum, si de nominibus & actionibus contentio?
13. Quale spectandum statutum, si de annuis reditibus contentio?
14. Quenam mobilium aut immobilium veniant nomine?
main_text.p: 1. HActenus explicui,& quidem facili negotio statutorum effectus absolutos; sunt etiam difficultates evolvendae, circa effectus statutorum comparatos; dum variorum locorum statuta dissonantia, circa unam eandemque rem, vel personam, vel negotia, concurrunt; quae longe prioribus sunt explicatione difficiliores. Quoad tamen fieri poterit, plerasque ex quibus de caeteris facile judicandum, in ordinem redigam, sicque me praestitisse,

page.notes: The large initial H is a woodcut-style letter joined to "Actenus" (rendered as HActenus). Original spelling kept, including "Aesdonico" and "Scabinico". The list items are set in italic with a sans-like numeral style; numerals are kept as printed. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page, continuing on the next page. Watermark "Digitized by Google" is excluded.
